text: Betla National Park is a national park located in the Latehar and Palamu district of Jharkhand, India. Its the only national park in the state. It is spread over an area of 226.32 km2 (87.38 sq mi) and is a part of the  Palamu Tiger Reserve.  It was declared a national park in 1986. The park hosts a wide variety of wildlife.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
